Hi there hello.

I’ve been told I’ve spent too much time making fun of luxury houses. So today we’re doing something completely different and much more dignified: luxury castles in the UK.

We’re heading across the pond to Scotland and England to tour million-pound stone fortresses featuring dungeon energy, migraine-inducing bedrooms, seven-knob showers that may or may not control gravy temperature, mysterious velvet-roped doors that definitely contain something unspeakable, and an alarming amount of wooden toilet seats that should not exist in any century.

Some of these castles are majestic.
Some are cursed.
Some are both.

If you’ve ever wondered what happens when medieval UK architecture collides with modern real estate listings, this is that.

Also yes, we will be returning to houses soon. Plea
title: Making Fun Of Dumb Luxury Castles
